description: Derived from AGSC-05-41: the shapes and the competency questions are evaluated over one data graph, the published `graph.nq` together with the closure of AGSC-05-37. The shape asks every `dom:Engine` for a `dom:controlled-by`. `engine-b` has one because the computed inverse of the `dom:controls` link of `ctl` is a triple of `graph.nq` (AGSC-03-27); `engine-a` has none, so the result is one violation with the message and the shape that the file gives. Of the two questions, `has-an-engine` is answered `true` and agrees; `engines` lists only `engine-a` while the data has two engines, so it differs. The case works on the evaluation itself, below the `verify` verb that `lint-0057` and `lint-0059` run.

questions.question: Does the site describe at least one engine?

questions.query: PREFIX dom: <https://minimal.example/ns/domain#> SELECT ?x WHERE { ?x a dom:Engine } ORDER BY ?x
questions.question: Which items are engines?
